newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures finish lower in quiet trading.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures finish lower in quiet trading.

text.p: June 17 - U.S. debt futures ended lower after a very quiet session. Traders said market drifted most of the day after early weakness on strong May industrial output/cap use. Traders cited profit-taking and overbought ideas. Still, Sept T-bond support at 111-11/32 went unchallenged.
